findings.title: Composition gate should pin final REVIEW_GO evidence paths

evidence.summary: Candidate requires reviewed commits and REVIEW_GO evidence before composition.
Same review commit still contains an earlier Writer contract REVIEW_NO_GO artifact.
Same review commit also contains the final Writer contract REVIEW_GO artifact.
Same runtime review commit still contains earlier Runtime Authority REVIEW_NO_GO artifacts.
Same runtime review commit also contains the final Runtime Authority REVIEW_GO artifact.

findings.recommended_disposition: Keep REVIEW_GO for this architecture. In WVO-SLICE-001, require exact final review evidence paths/generations in addition to review commit readability so automation cannot select an obsolete NO_GO artifact from the same commit.

residual_risks.summary: This architecture card does not implement sidecar revalidation, vNext tick, compatibility adapter or runtime digest checks; later slices must cover them with public-behavior RED/GREEN.
The activated review CodeGraph query returned semantically mismatched context; source confirmation was completed with bounded rg/nl/git show fallback.
